title: Ash Rain
text: Grey flakes begin to fall from a sky with no fire under it, slow and fat as first snow. Where they land on skin they do not melt. They cling, and they are faintly warm, and they smell of a hearth that went out a long time ago.

options.label: Cover your faces and wait for the grey to stop.

outcomes.text: It falls the whole night, soft as breath on the back of the neck. Nobody sleeps.

options.label: Walk on through it, mouths shut.

outcomes.text: It is only ash, after all, though the Leader coughs grey all the next day and the cough steals the breath their spells need.
It gets into the eyes and the lungs and the joints of armor, and grinds there like grave dirt.

options.label: The Ravager paints their face with it.

outcomes.text: Grey as a corpse, and grinning. The ash is war-paint now, and the Ravager carries it into the next fight.
